steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three high-impact strategies cities can use to cut carbon emissions:

1. Expand and Electrify Low-Carbon Transportation  
   • Invest in frequent, affordable public transit (buses, trams, metro).  
   • Build safe networks of bike lanes and pedestrian paths.  
   • Electrify municipal fleets and install EV charging infrastructure.  

2. Improve Building Energy Efficiency  
   • Update building codes to require high-performance insulation, windows, and HVAC systems.  
   • Retrofit existing homes and offices with LED lighting, smart thermostats, and heat pumps.  
   • Offer incentives or low-interest loans for deep-energy-efficiency upgrades.  

3. Shift to Renewable Energy and Smart Grids  
   • Deploy rooftop solar, community solar gardens, and small-scale wind where feasible.  
   • Partner with utilities to source an increasing share of electricity from renewables.  
   • Implement smart-grid technologies and energy storage to balance supply and demand.
